name: Ronnie Rainbow
caption: The self-described ring veteran styled 'The Sacred Heart' who opened Sacred Heart Wrestling, writing its every announcement in one voice of rainbow rings, rainbow bridges and silver mountains and signing them 'RR'.

tenures.role: owner of the federation, who says he 'wrestled on all seven continents for about a half a century' before opening it
tenures.source: The fed's own recruiting advertisement (13 July 2008), signing announcement (22 July 2008) and tournament announcement (25 July 2008) on the Primetime Central forum.

name: Brotherman Quasar Jones
caption: Billed 'The Divine Impala', one of the first three wrestlers Sacred Heart Wrestling signed: a holy man whose crown of curled hair may reach the tops of the silver mountain.

tenures.source: The fed's own signing announcement on the Primetime Central forum, 22 July 2008.

name: The Father
caption: The second of Sacred Heart Wrestling's first three signings, introduced as a holy man for whom the quest for the Sacred Heart is a spiritual pilgrimage.

tenures.source: The fed's own signing announcement on the Primetime Central forum, 22 July 2008.

name: The Bonnacon
caption: The third of Sacred Heart Wrestling's first three signings, a mountainous man forged in myth who breathes in souls and expels flaming excrement, as the bestiary's bonnacon does.

tenures.source: The fed's own signing announcement on the Primetime Central forum, 22 July 2008.

identity.note: Distinct pending a verdict: a shared ring name, and nothing held names both federations (a lead, not a finding). The UiWF wing's The Bonnacon is a caged, fire-breathing creature wheeled out by the Local NVA Company around 2008; this fed's announcement of 22 July 2008 bills a mountainous mammoth of a man of that name who 'expels flaming excrement'. The name is the medieval bestiary's beast and the trait is the bestiary's own, so neither is a moniker of the character's: there is no shared moniker, and the two presentations differ (a caged monster mascot against a signed wrestler). Same year and some handler adjacency (this fed's owner also played Kenny Mercury, who carries a UiWF tenure of about 2008), but no document names both.
